equation_summary: Vanilla RNN. Per step s: h_s = tanh( h_{s-1} @ W + x_s ), with h in [B,N,H]. The transition is a FIXED matrix W applied to the previous hidden state plus the input, passed through a tanh nonlinearity. Weights W are shared across all timesteps. y_s = h_s. This is a closed NONLINEAR (tanh) vector transition, not an affine/linear scan.
